name: Stepper
whenToUse: A process done in order over several screens: onboarding, checkout, a setup wizard.

whenNotToUse.text: Sections people visit in any order

anatomy.description: number, or a check when complete; color is never the only signal.
horizontal, or vertical for long labels and narrow space.

do.caption: Four short steps; where you are and what’s left is clear at a glance.
do.example:
<Stepper
  className="w-[30rem] max-w-full"
  current={1}
  steps={[{ label: 'Account' }, { label: 'Plan' }, { label: 'Payment' }, { label: 'Review' }]}
/>

dont.caption: Nine steps: labels get crushed and the process feels endless — merge steps or go vertical.

a11y: An ordered list; each step says its status in words (“completed”, “current step”), and the current one has `aria-current="step"`.
Clickable completed steps are buttons; upcoming steps aren’t interactive.
Move focus to the new step’s heading when the step changes.

props.name: labelAlign
props.description: Horizontal only: "start" matches the indicator's left edge; "center" pins under it (short labels only).

props.name: onStepClick
props.description:
Makes completed steps clickable (their label becomes a button), so
people can jump back to a step they've done instead of pressing Back
repeatedly. Current and upcoming steps stay plain text.
